# ReDoS Vulnerability Fixture Patterns

# 1. Nested Quantifiers (Exponential)
(a+)+$
([a-zA-Z]+)*
((a+)?)*
(0+)+

# 2. Overlapping Alternations (Exponential)
(a|ab)+$
(x+|x+)+$
([0-9]+|[a-zA-Z0-9]+)+
(left|leftright)+

# 3. Known Real-World CVE Regexes
# CVE-2020-5243: uap-core exponential backtracking
(a+)+b
# CVE-2021-27290: npm trim-newlines polynomial/exponential
([ \t\r\n]+)+$
# Ambiguous prefix polynomial ReDoS
.*a.*b
.*foo.*bar
